svg.text: $ hardencheck scan .
hardencheck 0.1.0 v1
tests/fixtures/Dockerfile.bad
HIGH HCD002 Container runs as root (file)
no USER instruction: the container runs as root
fix: Add a non-root USER after the install steps and chown what it needs.
HIGH HCD003 Secret-looking value in ENV or ARG (line 2)
PASSWORD in build args/env
fix: Pass secrets at runtime or through a secret store; build args are visible in image history.
HIGH HCD003 Secret-looking value in ENV or ARG (line 3)
TOKEN in build args/env
fix: Pass secrets at runtime or through a secret store; build args are visible in image history.
HIGH HCD005 Remote script piped into a shell (line 5)
RUN curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | sh
fix: Download, verify a checksum, then execute, so a compromised endpoint cannot run code silently.
MEDIUM HCD001 Base image is unpinned or uses :latest (line 1)
FROM ubuntu:latest
fix: Pin the base image to a specific version or digest so builds are reproducible.
MEDIUM HCD007 World-writable permissions on a file (line 6)
RUN chmod -R 777 /app
fix: Grant the narrowest permissions that work; world-writable files can be rewritten by any process.
